annotations.message: Mimir Ingester in {{ $labels.cluster }}/{{ $labels.namespace }} got a corrupted TSDB WAL.

expressions.A:
{"model":{"datasource":{"type":"prometheus","uid":"mimir"},"expr":"# alert when there are more than one corruptions
count by (cluster, namespace) (sum by (cluster, namespace, job) (rate(cortex_ingester_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total[5m]) > 0)) > 1
and
# and there are multiple zones
count by (cluster, namespace) (group by (cluster, namespace, job) (cortex_ingester_tsdb_wal_corruptions_total)) > 1","instant":false,"intervalMs":60000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"range":true,"refId":"A"},"datasource_uid":"mimir","query_type":"","relative_time_range":{"from":"10m0s","to":"0s"}}
